dominant_strengths: Confident headline typography with tight tracking and strong hierarchy anchors the dark hero with clarity and authority
Three-path 'How do you want to build?' selector is a smart behavioral entry point that segments users without overwhelming them
Dark navy backdrop with subtle grain gives depth and lets product screenshots pop with genuine craft
dominant_weaknesses: Cookie banner lands directly over the AI site builder card, blocking the most novel CTA and damaging first-impression trust
Three option cards feel visually inconsistent — preview imagery sits at different scales and crops, breaking the grid rhythm
Generic 'growth engine' tagline plus stock SaaS dark-blue palette undercuts Webflow's historical design distinctiveness
fix_priorities: Reposition cookie consent to a corner toast so the hero's primary conversion path is unobstructed
Normalize the three card previews to a shared crop, scale, and baseline to restore systematic rhythm
Push palette beyond default SaaS navy — introduce a signature accent or texture to reclaim brand distinctiveness
Tighten subhead copy; three short sentences read as committee-written rather than confident
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral leads via the clear three-path chooser, visceral is solid but conventional, and reflective payoff is muted by generic positioning copy.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it functions as a credible Webflow marketing hero, but it reads as competent category-standard rather than a design-tool company flexing its own craft.
